name: List Box Sign requests
description: List Box Sign requests Gets signature requests created by a user. GET /2.0/sign_requests
context:
GET /2.0/sign_requests
Gets signature requests created by a user. If the `sign_files` and/or `parent_folder` are deleted, the signature request will not return in the list.
Optional: marker (query) — Defines the position marker at which to begin returning results. This is used when paginating using marker-based pagination. This requires `usemarker` to be set to `true`.; limit (query) — The maximum number of items to return per page.; senders (query) — A list of sender emails to filter the signature requests by sender. If provided, `shared_requests` must be set to `true`.; shared_requests (query) — If set to `true`, only includes requests that user is not an owner, but user is a collaborator. Collaborator access is determined by the user access level of the sign files of the request. Default is `false`. Must be set to `true` if `senders` are provided.

name: Get Box Sign request by ID
description: Get Box Sign request by ID Gets a sign request by ID. GET /2.0/sign_requests/{sign_request_id}

name: Create Box Sign request
description: Create Box Sign request Creates a signature request. POST /2.0/sign_requests
context:
POST /2.0/sign_requests
Creates a signature request. This involves preparing a document for signing and sending the signature request to signers.
Optional: body (body)

name: Cancel Box Sign request
description: Cancel Box Sign request Cancels a sign request. POST /2.0/sign_requests/{sign_request_id}/cancel
context:
POST /2.0/sign_requests/{sign_request_id}/cancel
Cancels a sign request.
Required: sign_request_id (path) — The ID of the signature request.
Optional: body (body)

name: Resend Box Sign request
description: Resend Box Sign request Resends a signature request email to all outstanding signers. POST /2.0/sign_requests/{sign_request_id}/resend
context:
POST /2.0/sign_requests/{sign_request_id}/resend
Resends a signature request email to all outstanding signers.
Required: sign_request_id (path) — The ID of the signature request.
